Now in its third edition, this system includes a tension-type headache (TTH) category, further defined as either episodic (frequent and infrequent) or chronic. In infrequent episodic TTH, headache episodes occur less than one day a month, whereas in frequent episodic TTH, headache episodes occur 1 to 14 days a month. rag_sources.excerpt: Trichomoniasis is thought to be widely underdiagnosed owing to various factors, including a lack of routine testing, the low sensitivity of a commonly used diagnostic technique (wet mount microscopy), and nonspecific symptomatology. Self-diagnosis and self-treatment or diagnosis by practitioners without adequate laboratory testing may also contribute to misdiagnosis.
